positions.title: Seasonal Relief Employee
positions.description: Seasonal position to work alongside full time storeroom specialist employees to aid in receiving, moving and shipping materials from the Pewaukee Distribution Center to other company facilities.

positions.title: Information Technology Support Technician
positions.description: Worked closely with a team of fellow technicians to assess technology related issues brought to us by both student and faculty users. This ranges from help regarding university-specific services as well as general tech support. Allows me to continue to utilize a variety of skills as well as grow my own personal knowledge by working with others to come to solutions in an effective and efficient manner.

positions.title: Counter Manager
positions.description: Worked as the sole counter attendant responsible for interaction with all customers as well as managing close-knit team of field referees to keep club operations running efficiently.

positions.title: Boy Scout Summer Camp Counselor
positions.description: Responsible for creating and delivering lessons to multiple sessions of campers as well as working closely with a team of individuals specific to our program area to plan and host events throughout each session of camp.

honors.title: Order of the Arrow Vigil Honor
honors.description: The Order of the Arrow is the National Honor Society for the Boy Scouts of America. Vigil Honor is the highest level achievable and is only obtainable through nomination from peers in the council.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jun 2020

volunteerExperiences.description: Founder & President of the ACM UW-Whitewater Student chapter, an organization dedicated to seeking further projects and experience in the field of computer science.
Transitioned into adult leadership position upon turning 18 in order to stay involved with Scouting and continue to guide youth.

projects.title: JP Morgan Software Engineering Virtual Experience
projects.description:
Over the period of November 2021, Nick Murphy has completed practical task modules in:

Interface with a stock price data feed: 
- Manipulating financial data
- Using Python, Git, and basic programming skills

Use JPMorgan Chase frameworks and tools:
- Modification of web applications
- Using React and Typescript

Display data visually for traders:
- Using skills such as technical communication and financial analysis
- Modification of web applications

projects.title: Eagle Scout Project
projects.description: Planned a project to build an elevated garden bed with fountain and seating at a local memory care facility for residents to enjoy. Proposed project plans to council, then went through with fundraising, purchasing materials and leading a team of volunteers to build project as part of earning rank of Eagle Scout.
